# hecate.demo.wait

Suspends the running coroutine for `seconds`, then returns how long it waited.

## Syntax

```lua
---@async
---@param seconds number
---@param options? { quiet: boolean }
---@return number waited
function demo.wait(seconds, options) end
```

## Parameters and return values

### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `seconds` | `number` | how long to wait; `0` yields |
| `options?` | `{ quiet: boolean }` | behaviour switches |

### Return values

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `waited` | `number` | the time waited, in seconds |

## Errors raised

Raises [`hecate.demo.CounterError`](../CounterError.md) if `seconds` is negative, and `hecate.core.CancellationError`
if the enclosing scope is cancelled.

## May suspend

May suspend the running coroutine (`---@async`): other computations run while it waits. Call it from a coroutine managed by the reactor.

## Examples

None yet.

## Specifications and standards

Implements RFC 2119, section 1, for no good reason.

## Compatibility

Introduced in hecate 0.x. Lua 5.5.
